title: How Long Do You Have Left To Live?
summary: Thirty lifestyle questions reveal your playful life-clock estimate.

landing.intro:
What does your lifestyle say about your life clock?
Find out in thirty questions.

about.body:
This thirty-question quiz explores everyday habits, energy, relationships and outlook in one continuous challenge.

Select the answer that fits you, then press Next Question. There are no right or wrong answers and no time limit.

Your result is a playful age estimate and lifestyle profile, not a medical prediction or a reliable estimate of life expectancy.

steps: Choose the answer that best describes you.
Select an answer, then press Next Question to continue.
Finish all 30 questions to reveal your estimate.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz does not predict lifespan, health, mortality risk or medical outcomes. If you have health concerns, speak to a qualified healthcare professional.

stage-1.preAdCopy: All 30 answers have been compared. Your final age estimate and clock profile are ready.

centenarian_energy.title: Centenarian Energy
centenarian_energy.copy: Your answers suggest steady routines, everyday movement and small choices that are easy to repeat. You make consistency feel natural rather than restrictive.

steady_long_game.title: The Steady Long Game
steady_long_game.copy: Your routine has practical, sustainable energy. You tend to favour choices that keep life moving without demanding a dramatic reinvention.

balanced_realist.title: The Balanced Realist
balanced_realist.copy: Your answers blend sensible habits with enough flexibility to keep life enjoyable. You know consistency matters, but perfection is not required.

weekend_chaos.title: Weekend Chaos Mode
weekend_chaos.copy: Your choices carry bright, spontaneous energy. The plan may change, but you usually leave with a story worth telling.

stress_sprinter.title: The Stress Sprinter
stress_sprinter.copy: You can move quickly when pressure rises, sometimes at the expense of recovery. Your strongest upgrade would be better pacing, not less ambition.

comfort_creature.title: The Comfort Creature
comfort_creature.copy: You value familiarity, ease and a dependable place to recharge. Your sweet spot is comfortable living with just enough novelty and movement.

adventure_fuse.title: Adventure Fuse
adventure_fuse.copy: Your answers have curious, say-yes energy. You are drawn to fresh experiences, movement and the possibility that an ordinary day could become memorable.

reset_needed.title: Reset Needed
reset_needed.copy: Your routine appears to be asking for fewer small fires and more room to recover. A calmer rhythm may feel more useful than another ambitious overhaul.

reviewUnlock.title: See what shaped your estimate
reviewUnlock.copy: Review each choice and see whether it moved your estimate up, down or kept it neutral.
reviewUnlock.adNote: One short ad, then see what shaped your estimate.
reviewUnlock.raisedCopy: This answer added an upward lifestyle signal to the estimate.
reviewUnlock.loweredCopy: This answer added a downward lifestyle signal to the estimate.
reviewUnlock.neutralCopy: This answer added context without meaningfully moving the estimate.

estimate.disclaimer: For entertainment only. This is not a medical or life-expectancy prediction.

yl-s1q1.question: Your alarm rings. What happens next?

answers.a3: I get up after a moment
answers.a4: I am usually up before it

yl-s1q2.question: A surprise free hour lands in your day. What do you do?

answers.a3: Do something useful, then relax
answers.a4: Head out and make it count

yl-s1q3.question: Your plans suddenly change. What is your honest first reaction?

answers.a2: I need a while to reset
answers.a3: I adjust without much drama
answers.a4: Excellent, now anything could happen

yl-s1q4.question: At 2 p.m., which version of you usually appears?

answers.a3: Still moving at a steady pace
answers.a4: Ready for a second wind

yl-s1q5.question: How does your to-do list usually end the day?

answers.a2: The easy jobs are gloriously crossed off
answers.a3: The important things are mostly handled
answers.a4: Finished, with tomorrow already planned

yl-s1q6.question: A room gets unexpectedly messy. What happens?

answers.a2: I tidy when it starts bothering me
answers.a3: I reset it before the day ends
answers.a4: I clean it before chaos gets ideas

yl-s2q1.question: Breakfast is available. Which option sounds most like you?

answers.a3: Something filling and sensible
answers.a4: A proper start I actually enjoy

yl-s2q2.question: You notice stairs beside an elevator. What do you choose?

answers.a3: Stairs if it is only a few floors
answers.a4: Stairs, and I may race the doors

yl-s2q3.question: Your body asks for movement. How quickly do you listen?

answers.a3: I make room for it most days
answers.a4: Movement is already part of my routine

yl-s2q4.question: The afternoon slump arrives. What is your rescue plan?

answers.a3: Water, food, or a short break
answers.a4: A quick walk and a full reset

yl-s2q5.question: How often does a meal feel genuinely satisfying afterward?

answers.a1: Rarely; I am still hunting for something
answers.a2: It depends how rushed I was
answers.a3: Most of the time
answers.a4: Almost always; I know what works for me

yl-s2q6.question: A friend suggests a long walk. Your first thought?

answers.a3: That sounds pleasant
answers.a4: Shoes on. Where are we going?

yl-s3q1.question: A deadline moves closer. What happens inside your head?

answers.a1: Every alarm goes off at once
answers.a2: I avoid it until urgency wins
answers.a3: I break it into manageable pieces
answers.a4: I focus and enjoy the momentum

yl-s3q2.question: Your phone fills with unread messages. What is your move?

answers.a1: Pretend the phone no longer exists
answers.a3: Work through them when I have space
answers.a4: Clear them before they become a cloud

yl-s3q3.question: Someone cancels dinner at the last minute. What now?

answers.a3: I make a new plan for myself
answers.a4: I invite someone else or go anyway

yl-s3q4.question: When stress spikes, who usually notices first?

answers.a3: Someone close to me
answers.a4: I spot it early and respond

yl-s3q5.question: A friend asks for help during your busiest week. You...

answers.a3: Help within a clear limit
answers.a4: Find a practical solution together

yl-s3q6.question: How easily can you say no without replaying it later?

answers.a1: I am still replaying one from 2019
answers.a2: Not easily, but I am learning
answers.a3: Usually, when the boundary matters
answers.a4: Cleanly and kindly

yl-s4q1.question: A mystery day trip begins in one hour. Are you going?

answers.a3: Yes, if the basics are covered
answers.a4: I am already packing snacks

yl-s4q2.question: A song you love starts playing in public. What happens?

answers.a3: I sing along quietly
answers.a4: The performance has begun

yl-s4q3.question: You are offered a completely new dish. Your response?

answers.a3: Why not? I will try it
answers.a4: Make mine the strangest option

yl-s4q4.question: Rain ruins the outdoor plan. What is plan B?

answers.a3: Swap in an indoor adventure
answers.a4: Keep going; rain is part of the story

yl-s4q5.question: Which forgotten hobby are you most likely to restart?

answers.a3: A skill I used to enjoy
answers.a4: Something I have never tried before

yl-s4q6.question: You get invited to karaoke. Which version of you arrives?

answers.a3: One carefully chosen song
answers.a4: Unexpected headline act

yl-s5q1.question: Your future self sends one message back. What does it say?

answers.a1: Please slow down before I have to
answers.a3: Keep choosing what actually matters
answers.a4: Say yes to the stories worth keeping

yl-s5q2.question: Which small habit would be easiest to keep for a year?

answers.a3: A regular walk or check-in
answers.a4: Trying one new thing each week

yl-s5q3.question: You wake up tomorrow with a completely free weekend. What gets planned first?

answers.a3: One worthwhile plan
answers.a4: Somewhere I have never been

yl-s5q4.question: Which compliment would you most like your older self to give you?

answers.a3: You stayed true to what mattered
answers.a4: You never stopped being curious

yl-s5q5.question: You are given some unexpected spending money, just for fun. Where does it go?

answers.a2: Something I have wanted for ages
answers.a3: A mix of sensible and enjoyable
answers.a4: An experience I will still talk about years later

yl-s5q8.question: Without overthinking it, how far does your inner clock feel set to run?

answers.a1: It is asking for a serious reset
answers.a3: Long enough to surprise a few people
answers.a4: Far beyond everyone's expectations
